maddeler.e:
تخترطون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِطُونَ (taḵtariṭūna) /tax.ta.ri.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# تُخْتَرَطُونَ (tuḵtaraṭūna) /tux.ta.ra.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
